author: Heidi Kemps
description: If you were an arcade operator 45 years ago, your first look at a game that would change the history of the medium came in the form of a humble sales flyer. On the front was a detailed cartoon illustration that envisioned the game's premise: an ape throwing barrels down scaffolding, a terrified damsel in distress posing behind it, and a smug, mustachioed man in overalls posed to indicated that he was going to take that mad monkey down. It's among the first images of Donkey Kong, the first appearance of Mario, and the game that propelled Nintendo to international success.
title: An Iconic Piece Of Gaming Artwork Just Fetched A Princely Sum At Auction

author: Phil Hornshaw
description:
There's a lot to love about soulslike games, but one of the things in the negative columns for a lot of players is how much time they can suck up. And while Phantom Blade Zero is an action-RPG that's not quite a soulslike, it's similar enough that some players might look at its super-fast combat and exceedingly tough boss battles and decide to take a pass.

But if you're the kind of person who is souls-curious or looking for a soulslike game with a little less commitment, Phantom Blade Zero might be for you. It uses a number of elements of the genre's formula, with some key tweaks to make progress a little faster. The biggest one: boss fights that give you checkpoints in the middle.
title: Phantom Blade Zero Fixes The Struggle That Might Be Keeping You Away From Soulslikes

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
Take-Two's biggest release ever, GTA 6, is coming up in November, but the company's share price continues to drop. It's down 21% this year and has now dipped under $200 this week after reaching a 52-week high of $265.

In short, the stock is struggling, but one big bank says it sees a lot of upside, in part because Rockstar is expected to release a new version of GTA Online--potentially in the first quarter of 2027--that could generate
title: GTA 6 Online Could Be Released In Early 2027, Bank Says

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
The Lord of the Rings Online, an MMO based on the popular fantasy series, got its latest expansion today, some 19.5 years after the game was originally released in 2007.

The new expansion is called The Wolves of Mordor, and as its name suggests, the expansion is focused on the werewolves of Mordor who are going after the people who took down their master, Sauron.

The expansion takes players beyond Gorgoroth where they will "gather unlikely allies and uncover the secrets hidden in Mordor's forgotten corners." Players will visit three new regions: Heledhris, Parth Rhavas, and Nan Ogol. In those places, players can learn new skills and receive enhancements, an
title: LOTRO’s Latest Expansion Is Out Now, Nearly 20 Years After The Game Launched

author: Phil Owen
description: Fortnite's very last new collaboration for this year's Halloween season is with Predator: Badlands, and it includes the first Predator skin that's ever been available outside the permanently locked Chapter 2 Season 5 battle pass. But the main attraction in this set may actually be the back bling, which is the top half of Thia, the Weyland-Yutani android, played by Elle Fanning, who spends most of the movie strapped to the protagonist's back. The whole Predator: Badlands set hits the Fortnite shop on October 28 at 5 PM PT / 8 PM ET.
title: Fortnite Is About To Sell Half An Elle Fanning In The Item Shop

author: Cameron Koch
description:
Developer Blizzard's new version of its flagship MMORPG, World of Warcraft: Forever, will receive content updates "every four months," avoiding modern WoW's somewhat controversial eight-week patch cycle.

In an interview with IGN, Forever principal game designer Kris Zierhut revealed the content schedule plan and explained Blizzard's reasoning. He said WoW Classic's Season of Discovery received updates "way too fast," every 8-10 weeks.

Since the launch of WoW's Dragonflight expansion in 2022, an eight-week update schedule is also what modern WoW operates on. Its more frequent patch schedule means there's always something new to do, but has been criticized by some players due to the
title: WoW: Forever Content Updates Will Come Slower Than You Might Expect

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description: Like many video game movies, Sleeping Dogs seems stuck in development hell. Even though it looked like progress on this adaptation of the cult-classic action game was once again picking up when Shang-Chi star Simu Liu started teasing new developments last year, and Timo Tjahjanto (Nobody 2) was later announced as the director, there's been little word since on whether the film will ever get off the ground. What's taking so long? Ac
title: Sleeping Dogs Movie Director Explains Why The Adaptation Is Taking So Long

author: S.E. Doster
description:
Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 just released on October 23, but Season 1 is already scheduled to arrive next week. This inaugural season includes the game's first battle pass, more weapons, and a new DMZ map. Warzone's integration is also included with the big update, bringing two Modern Warfare-themed maps to Call of Duty's battle royale.

Call of Duty Season 1 start times

Season 1 of Modern Warfare 4 and Warzone arrives on November 6. Call of Duty is shifting back to later releases for post-launch updates this year, with Season 1 arriving on November 6 at 12 AM ET / 5 AM GMT and on November 5 at 9 PM PT.

What to expect from Season 1
title: CoD: Modern Warfare 4 And Warzone Season 1 Release Date And Details

author: Evan Campbell
description:
The latest Indie World Showcase only lasted for a bit longer than 15 minutes, but that small time window didn't stop Nintendo from featuring some truly cool-looking games. The Witchbrook release date announcement kicked things off for the presentation. While definitely exciting, that's not what enthralled me the most.

That's because the next unveiling was Winds of Viridia, an action-adventure game from developer Shark Jump that appears inspired by The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild. You play as a brown-haired boy who teams up with an adorable mothbug. But the cute companion is also apparently lethal against foes. Other things we're digging about this singl
title: Nintendo’s Indie World Presentation Was Pretty Packed For A Short Show

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
Rockstar's GTA 6 is expected to be a giant success commercially, but just how big does the game need to be to actually be successful following a decade of development and perhaps one of the biggest development budgets ever? We don't know, because Take-Two doesn't disclose that kind of information, but EA founder Bing Gordon has his own thoughts.

description:
PlayStation has revealed this month's batch of free games for PlayStation Plus subscribers. All PS Plus members will be able to claim a trio of freebies starting November 3: Dead Island 2, Tomb Raider 4-6 Remastered, and Monster Train 2. If you haven't claimed October's PlayStation Plus free games yet, make sure to do so before next Tuesday.

title: PlayStation Plus Free Games For November 2026 Revealed

author: Chris Compendio
description:
The latest Nintendo Indie World Showcase highlighted several independent games arriving on Switch and Switch 2 in the coming months, and you can try some of them starting today. Four demos and a full game shadow-dropped on the Nintendo eShop, including a fantastical action-adventure and a coin machine roguelike that's sure to hook you.

Winds of Viridia demo

It's hard to deny that Winds of Viridia is giving off some light Breath of the Wild vibes, with a bright art style and a major focus on exploration. Expec
title: Every October 2026 Nintendo Indie World Game You Can Play Right Now

author: Chris Pereira
description:
I often feel compelled to beeline my way through games--I'll do plenty of optional quests, but rarely do I find myself slowing down to take in the sights or just goof around. It's pedal to the metal at all times. My Arms Are Longer Now, which was featured in today's Nintendo Indie World stream, is the rare game to break me out of that compulsion.

A demo was recently released for My Arms Are Longer Now, and despite consisting of just the game's opening level, I spent much longer with it than I would have expected. I often treat demos as a quick taste to get an impression of something before moving on, especially during Next Fests. In the case of My Arms Are Longer Now's demo, I did everything I could and relished in messing around, whether or not doing so connected to any actual objective.
title: Nintendo Indie World’s Weirdest Game Got Me To Relax

author: Jade King
description:
Eight years after its reveal, magical cozy game Witchbrook finally has a release date. We’ve been waiting a painfully long time for this Kiki’s Delivery Service-inspired pixel-art experience to break cover, and now we finally know it will be coming to PS5, Xbox Series X|S, PC, Nintendo Switch, and Nintendo Switch 2 on January 28, 2027. So you’ll have plenty of time to complete GTA 6 before diving into this severe tonal shift. 

At first glance, Witchbrook seems like yet another comfortable life sim along the same lines as Coral Island, Stardew Valley, Story of Seasons, and countless others. The genre is super popular, so developers need to do something incredibly impressive in order to stand out. I’m a sucker for these games even if they don’t push the boat out, but Witchbrook seems awfully d
title: Witchbrook Is Stardew Valley Meets Kiki’s Delivery Service, And It Finally Has A Release Date

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
Sony is embracing one of the best trends of the late '90s and early 2000s, revealing a new line of DualSense controllers and PlayStation 5 console covers with transparent materials. Dubbed the Prism Collection, it will come in three distinct glossy colors: Flare Orange, Emerald Green, and Graphite Gray.  Preorders will open on November 10 through the PlayStation Direct store ahead of a February 4, 2027 rollout.

Sony says the design was inspired by the PS5 design team's interest in giving the console and its accessories a transparent look while also showing off the hardware beneath the protective surface. Flare Orange has a "bold and vibrant aesthetic," Emerald Green offers an "elegant" finish, and Sony says a PS5 will look "refined" with a Graphite Gray cover.
title: Sony Is Bringing The Best Trend Of ’90s Console Design To PS5

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
State of Decay 3 made an impact at the 2020 Xbox Games Showcase with a slick trailer that teased features that wouldn't make the final cut, like undead deer and frigid landscapes. Six years later, things have changed at developer Undead Labs as it navigates life after Xbox and a shift in gameplay design that led the studio to ditch ideas to make State of Decay 3 an MMO.

Undead Labs founder Jeff Strain planned to make the threequel far bigger than its predecessors, and after his departure in 2019, several design team members kept building the tools to support that vision. Speaking to
title: Here’s Why State Of Decay 3 Has Taken 6 Years To Develop So Far

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
GTA 6 launches on November 19, and one day later, the new Hunger Games movie, Sunrise on the Reaping, comes to theaters. GTA 6 is expected to be an unprecedented hit that captures people's time and attention, especially right at launch. Will this impact Sunrise on the Reaping? That remains to be seen, but director Francis Lawrence hopes people can find time for both.

"Unfortunately, I think it comes out right around the same time our movie does. Hopefully, people find time for both. Play GTA
title: New Hunger Games Movie Comes Out The Day After GTA 6, But Is The Director Scared?

author: Ben Janca
description:
As the colder months approach, the wanderlust within us begins to show its first symptoms: an ache for picturesque locations where we can relax in the sun among white sandy beaches and sky-blue oceans. If you're planning a trip, perhaps we can suggest the idyllic islands of Titan Quest II's Ancient Greece? It's beautiful, clean, and hosts wonders the likes of what you've never seen. If you're worried about the logistics of going back in time, don't! There are SO many other things you should be worried about on this trip, from deadly monsters to vengeful deities. Take a look at our TitanQuest II tourism guide to learn more about this luxurious locale.

Take a vacation to the isles of Titan Quest II when it releases for PC, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X and S on January 19th, 2027. Pre-order the console version now and get a Cosmic Turtle Companion as a free pre-order bonus
title: Come Visit Greece in Titan Quest II!

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
Nintendo's new Indie World Showcase was a rapid-fire look at upcoming Switch games from a variety of third-party partners--which included several raccoon-themed games amongst the various titles. If you missed it, here's everything announced, from a Witchbrook release date to a sizzle reel of games landing early in 2027.

Witchbrook

And we're off! The first trailer shown off was for the cute witch game, Witchbrook. The cozy spellcasting game releases on January 28, 2027.

Winds of Viridia

author: Callum Self
description:
Whether you’ve got that spooky playlist set up with some frightening tunes or you’re preparing for a horror game marathon, I’ve got a great bundle for you. In celebration of Halloween, Fanatical’s Haunted Mystery Bundle comes with five Steam keys that are made for the scariest event of the year, and fortunately, there are no tricks here—although you could be treated to a massive triple-A prize with games like Silent Hill: Townfall or The Blood of Dawnwalker.

If you’re like me, chances are you’re too old to go out trick-or-treating. It’s one of the worst things about getting old, besides the creaky back and knee pains when you pick something up. Sometimes, you want to skip out on the typical horror movie marathon and play some games, and if so, this bundle is just for you.
title: Celebrate Halloween By Getting Five Spooky Mystery Games For Under $7

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
Rockstar's GTA 6 is expected to be an enormous, unprecedented success when it releases on November 19, and new data only backs that up further.

Circana has released new data that shows that GTA 6 holds 29% purchase intent among US console and PC gamers. That means nearly 1 in 3 console and PC gamers in the US plan to buy GTA 6--this is the highest purchase intent that Circana has ever measured for any game.

Circana's Mat Piscatel
title: GTA 6 Breaks A Record, And It’s Not Even Out Yet

title: Mobile Suit Gundam: BATTLE OPERATION 3 – Official Announcement Trailer

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
Kane Parsons made one of 2026's most highly acclaimed and commercially successful movies in Backrooms, and everyone wants to know what he'll do next. A lot of people think he's going to make a Portal movie, based on Valve's hit series, and his latest appearance has fans convinced that's on tap.

Parsons recently appeared on Kyle Buchanan's podcast wearing a Valve hoodie. Parsons is a huge fan of Valve and its work, so he very well may have been wearing the hoodie like anyone wears a piece of clothing bearing the name or logo of their favorite thing. But others believe it was an intentional choice by Parsons to wear the Valve hoodie to stoke the rumors of a Portal movie.
title: Backrooms Director Wears A Valve Hoodie To Interview And People Think He’s Teasing A Portal Movie

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
Steam Next Fest has come and gone, and one of the big criticisms of the semi-regular showcase for game demos--aside from there being several thousand of them--was that there was simply too much AI slop floating to the top. Valve has responded to the feedback, and for now, its solution to avoiding hastily vibe-coded game demos is to simply be patient and wait a few days before diving in.

Speaking at the Steam Indie Connect developer event (via Inven Global), Tom Giardino and Marc Wilkin
title: Valve Knows Steam Next Fest Has An AI Slop Problem, And It’s Looking For Solutions
